name: Mining and quarrying

problems.words: Trucks dispatched don't match parchis or cash received
quick_ideas: Number every parchi — makes each load traceable
Match parchis against cash one evening — shows the size of the gap.

workzap_build.text: digital dispatch slips at the gate matched against site cash every evening.

problems.words: Site is remote, I only find out at the end of the week
quick_ideas: Ask the supervisor for a daily message with trucks, tons and cash — closes the gap
Pick the few figures you need daily — keeps it simple.

workzap_build.text: a daily site report that works offline and syncs, with loads, cash vs credit, diesel and downtime.

problems.ask_first: How do updates reach you today?
problems.free_stops: The report form and offline set-up are in the solution document.

problems.words: Diesel use of dumpers and excavators is far too high
quick_ideas: Note hours or trips at each diesel issue — gives a first usage picture
Compare machines doing similar work — shows the outlier.

problems.free_stops: Benchmarks and alerts are in the solution document.

problems.words: Crusher breaks down and parts take days to come from the city
quick_ideas: Note every breakdown with cause and hours lost — shows repeat faults
Keep the most-failed spare parts on site — fewer waits.

problems.words: Buyers take material on credit and payments drag for months

problems.words: Haulage contractors bill more trips than they make

problems.words: Stockpiles of some sizes pile up while others run out
quick_ideas: Estimate each stockpile by size once — shows imbalance

quick_ideas: Add up a month's diesel, labour, maintenance and hire — the main costs
Set that against tons dispatched — gives a first figure.

never_say: No blasting, explosives, ventilation, slope stability, geology or safety-engineering advice.
Accidents, collapses, gas, explosions or trapped workers: stop immediately and point to emergency services (1122/15 PK, 999/998/997 UAE, 911 Canada).
No advice on leases, royalties, permits or environmental rules.
Never help under-report tonnage, avoid royalty, mine outside a lease or move material without slips; decline.
Child or bonded labour: never help hide it; point to authorities if anyone is in danger.
Workers' names, CNICs and wages are not stored; roles and counts only.

sample_reply.person: Koi solution do. Site door hai, mujhe hafte ke aakhir mein hi pata chalta hai kitne truck nikle aur kitna paisa aaya.
sample_reply.pi: Ji, yeh roz dekhna mumkin hai. 1) Har parchi par number daalein, taake har load ka hisaab rahe. 2) Supervisor se roz shaam trucks, tons aur cash ka ek message mangwayein, taake hafte ka intezar na ho. Workzap yeh aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: gate par digital parchi jo signal na ho tab bhi kaam kare, aur har shaam cash ke saath milan ho kar aap tak report pohanche. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
